main.clearHistoryBody: Are you sure you want to delete all chat sessions? This action cannot be undone and all conversations will be permanently deleted.
main.noResponse: Sorry, I could not generate a response.
main.requestError: Sorry, there was an error processing your request. Please try again.
main.startError: Sorry, there was an error starting this chat. Please try again.
main.switchBody: Switching to {{model}} will start a new chat. Your current conversation stays available in the sidebar.
main.knowledgeBaseTooltip: When on, the assistant searches your knowledge base for relevant documents before answering. Turning this off is faster and lighter on hardware, which helps when your knowledge base is small or empty. This is the same setting as in AI Assistant settings.
main.thinkingTooltip: When on, this model works through its reasoning before answering. Slower, but often better on tricky questions. Your choice is remembered for this model; the default for other models is set in AI Assistant settings.
